column2: Volt set the scooter's clock right before this test, so the scooter may not be keeping the time it's given. Until that's solved, a smart plug is a safer timer. Report an issue with diagnostics so we can look into it.
column3: Volt ha impostato l'orologio del monopattino subito prima di questo test, quindi il monopattino potrebbe non mantenere l'ora impostata. Finché non sarà risolto, una presa smart è un timer più sicuro. Segnala un problema allegando la diagnostica, così potremo esaminarlo.
column4: Volt set the scooter's clock immediately before this test, so the scooter may not keep the set time. Until this is resolved, a smart plug is a safer timer. Report a problem attaching the diagnostics, so we can examine it.

column2: The battery reached its charge limit during the test, so it couldn't tell. Test again further below the limit.

column4: The battery reached the charge limit during the test, so it was not possible to determine the outcome. Run the test again starting from a charge farther from the limit.
